analysis_protocol.case_bootstrap: Paired per-case success differences; sample 50 cases with replacement within each prespecified suite; percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals
analysis_protocol.task_cluster_bootstrap: Sample ten tasks with replacement, retaining each selected task's five paired initial states; percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals
analysis_protocol.seed: SHA256(manifest hash, frozen suite/better/worse, method); independent of observed outcomes
analysis_protocol.primary_tests: One-sided exact conditional McNemar for each frozen better>worse direction; Holm-adjusted across exactly two hypotheses
analysis_protocol.stability: Positive paired difference, both bootstrap lower bounds >0, and positive leave-one-task-out and leave-one-init-out differences
analysis_protocol.interpretation: Support complementarity only when both frozen directions meet stability; otherwise distinguish positive directions with uncertainty from directions not reproduced. No single p threshold determines the conclusion.
analysis_protocol.caveats: Ten task clusters and five initial states limit precision; bootstrap intervals are approximate. Non-significance is not equivalence. Other categories are descriptive; no path or suite reselection.

reason: Independent confirmation has not been frozen

records.interpretation: This study pins each model process to one UUID. A process listed on multiple study GPUs is external to these single-GPU jobs. Current wall/RPC timing may include shared hardware contention; no wall pacing means simulator quality remains valid unless a technical failure occurs. No external process was stopped.
records.timing_scope: Do not interpret affected wall-clock timings as exclusive-GPU speed; retain all outcomes and use separately identified fixed-input probes/replication for cost.

resource_contention.model_binding: Each study model process is pinned to one GPU UUID; a recorded multi-GPU process is external to these jobs
resource_contention.timing_limit: These snapshots do not establish exclusive access or complete overlap intervals. Policy/RPC/wall time and even same-service fixed-input ratios can be affected by contention; do not report them as exclusive-GPU speed.
resource_contention.quality_handling: All valid scientific outcomes retained unchanged. Contention does not reclassify success/failure or authorize retries; technical failures remain separate.
